records.title: School (CHEO School Authority)
records.summary: CHEO School is a two-year English and French kindergarten program inside the CHEO Children's Treatment Centre in Ottawa for children with complex physical disabilities. Children must be Centre clients, 4 by December 31, with needs in two or more of physiotherapy, occupational therapy and speech-language pathology. The referring therapist applies by January 31; decisions are made by April 1 (families hear March to April). Applying does not guarantee a place.

records.title: CHEO School Programs
records.summary: Each student follows an IEP built on the Ontario Kindergarten Program with small classes of six to seven, a monthly multi-disciplinary team review and integrated therapy. School liaison teachers (special education teachers supervised by the principal) support transitions into school, between boards and to secondary school for Centre clients with a physical exceptionality.
